story.script: Three months before my wedding, my florist called and asked whether my family was running some kind of event business. I laughed because I thought she had the wrong person. She cancelled every unauthorized booking, honored my original price because I had reported it immediately, and changed my contract number. One of Melissa's customers then messaged me asking when she would get her deposit back. That was how I learned Melissa had also collected deposits herself. I removed her from every vendor chat that afternoon. She told mutual friends I had destroyed her side hustle. I told them she had built her side hustle inside my wedding.
story.twist: The florist calls about a fifth event booked under the bride's surname, even though the bride only has one wedding.

story.script: I was quietly applying for a few jobs because my team had been understaffed for months. I hadn't told anyone at work. Two weeks later, my boss finally approved the extra position our team had requested for months. Ryan tried to joke that his interference had helped. Nobody laughed. He wanted to stop me leaving and accidentally proved exactly why I was looking.
story.twist: A recruiter reveals that the teammate's email was accidentally included in an auto-forward rule on a shared professional association mailbox.

youtube.description: A secret job search reaches the boss through the last person who should see it.

story.script: My boyfriend's new headphones stopped charging after two days, so I took them back with the receipt while he was at work. Ben didn't get a chance to rescue me, and the presentation went perfectly. Afterward my director said, 'Funny how stable the file is now.' I didn't need to add anything. story.twist: Version history shows the errors were inserted minutes before meetings and then corrected immediately afterward.
